hypotheses.statement: The schema migration batch 2026-07-19 stalled because a statement attempted to acquire an exclusive lock on the public.orders table while other transactions held ACCESS SHARE locks on it.
The orders-service connection pool exhaustion contributed to the migration stall by preventing new connections from being available for lock acquisition or monitoring.

summary: A schema migration batch (2026-07-19) appears to have stalled while attempting to modify the public.orders table. Available evidence shows routine migration steps completing successfully on other tables with no lock waits, while lock monitor samples repeatedly show ACCESS SHARE locks on related tables but no recorded waiters on public.orders. Service objectives remained met throughout the observed period, and connection pool usage was within limits. The exact migration statement targeting public.orders and the specific lock contention are not captured in the provided evidence.
